actual_scope: Fixed g=2 deterministic extremal source pairs: prove all-24-order determinant and singular-value margins, paid tensor/inverse error transfer, and matched periodic alias tolerance under an explicit entry-error premise.
scope_change_reason: A11 supplies qualitative exact nonvanishing but leaves Cp margins open. General directed determinant classes need not be binomial. One approved narrowing selects the extremal centered phase n=-(s-1)/2, whose source factors occupy a uniform asymmetric parameter box.
bottleneck_link: Analytic recovery and precision interface: close a quantitative rounding gap for selected physical two-point factors, while preserving actual production, arbitrary phases, larger tiles and full-caller obligations.
stop_rule: Stop at the fixed two-axis source theorem and independent verification. Do not extend to arbitrary A11-good indices, larger dimensions or producer admission.
evidence: PROOF.md gives determinant >=exp(-4a)/16 and exact forward/inverse singular margins in all 24 orders. Factor entry error <=2^-34 exp(-4a), or <=2^-36 exp(-4a) after matched periodic aliases, suffices; p bits work for p>=4096. RESULT.json records symbolic order identities, exact Gram checks, certified source primes and failure controls. A three-axis symbolic duplicate-column control blocks unchanged box tensorization.
